text:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: Pagertree alert: billing-metering-service high token_count drift and delayed emit window (ingest latency). Impact: some customers showing overage flags. Oncall Pager: paging @alice-nguyen for billing-metrics.
Alice Nguyen: I'm on it, ack. Joining bridge now.
Alice Nguyen: initial check - ingestion lag spiked at 13:02 UTC, emitter queue backlog on kafka-partition-7.
Ben Ortiz: seeing gaps in counts and a delayed window job at 13:00. Might be a downstream consumer lag.
Charlie Kim: tagging billing service -- any deploys around that time?
Billing Service: no deploys, autoscaler kicked a pod restart around 12:59 for emitter-3. Logs attached: `Emitter restart: OOMKilled -> restarted`
SRE Lead: can we confirm whether the restart caused duplicate replay or missing ack?
Alice Nguyen: running quick query on tallies: `SELECT count(*) FROM token_emits WHERE ts >= 1680000000 AND source='emitter-3' GROUP BY window;` getting unexpected zeros for windows 13:00-13:05.
Eve Patel: customer support - getting two overage tickets from AcmeCorp and BrightApps. Both show sudden large token_count for 13:00.
Ben Ortiz: hypothesis: restart cleared KV offset and emitter re-emitted previously buffered messages -> duplication flagged as overage. But we also have delayed emits (some messages not emitted yet).
Charlie Kim: Oncall, can you enable shadow-mode for overage alerts (mute noisy flags) while we triage? We should avoid spamming customers.
Oncall Pager: muting alert channel for billing.overage.notify (10m). Slack reaction :mute:.
Alice Nguyen: mitigation plan: 1) mark suspicious windows as 'do-not-bill' in shadow ledger, 2) start immediate backfill reconcile job, 3) prevent further replays by pausing emitter-3.
Billing Service: pausing emitter-3 now: `kubectl scale deployment/emitter-3 --replicas=0 -n billing` -> succeeded.
Ben Ortiz: launching reconcile job (runbook step): `python tools/reconcile_window.py --window-start 2026-03-17T13:00:00Z --source emitter-3 --mode dry-run`
Alice Nguyen: switching to live reconcile (not dry-run). Creating patch to shadow ledger: `PATCH /internal/billing/adjustments` body: `{ "window": "2026-03-17T13:00:00Z", "reason": "suspected replay duplication", "action": "shadow_exempt" }`
Charlie Kim: added temporary metric: `billing.reconcile.duplicate_candidate` to track. Initial count: 243 windows flagged.
Eve Patel: I'll send templated customer message to affected accounts and pause auto-overage emails for them.
SRE Lead: parallel action - increase consumer parallelism for emitter-backfill to catch up safely: `consumer.instances=8 -> 16` and throttle to avoid DB overload.
Alice Nguyen: performing sanity checks on token hashes to detect duplication (compare payload ids). Example log snippet: ```
[13:02:12] emitter-3 INFO emitted token id=abc123 hash=9f8e...
[13:02:14] emitter-3 INFO emitted token id=abc123 hash=9f8e... (duplicate)
```
Ben Ortiz: looks like duplication detected by id match. Proceeding with de-dupe pipeline.
Billing Service: note: some delayed messages are still inbound from upstream aggregator; we'll hold them in staging until dedupe done.
Oncall Pager: handing off to SRE Lead for monitoring and postmortem. Paging @charlie-kim to take 1.
Charlie Kim: taking primary for post-incident actions. I'll keep the channel updated every 10m. Next update in 8m.
Alice Nguyen: estimated time to reconcile ~25min. Will update on completion and customer impact numbers.
Eve Patel: update to support: AcmeCorp initial overage flag removed for the 13:00 window, awaiting full reconcile.
SRE Lead: follow-ups: - root cause RCA: emitter pod OOM + auto-replay behavior -> change to graceful shutdown and checkpoint offsets. - postmortem owner: Alice. - mitigate: add preemptive offset checkpoint every 30s.
Ben Ortiz: creating infra ticket to add backpressure circuit-breaker for emitter restarts.
Charlie Kim: thanks team. Leaving oncall notes and adding action items to incident board: https://internal.redwood/ops/incidents/1739154321
OpsBot: Incident status changed -> mitigated (partial). Reaction :white_check_mark:.
